climate: A dry climate, with little rain while the vines grow. Water is scarce and the dry air keeps disease down.

blurb.text: A very small Columbia Valley AVA in Washington's Yakima County, on the western edge of the Columbia Basin. Every vineyard is biodynamic or LIVE certified, and the vines are mostly Pinot Gris, with Sauvignon Blanc and Syrah.
